title: How to enable web and browser notifications
description: Web notifications pop up while you're on >x<, while browser notifications work even when you're away. Enable either or both to stay updated on mentions, likes, follows, direct messages, and more.

toc.title: When will I receive web or browser notifications?
How do I set up push notifications on my mobile device?

runs: A web notification is a pop-up that appears within your web browser to notify you about what’s happening on >x< when you’re on x.com and logged in to your account. If you’re using Chrome or Firefox you can also turn on browser notifications, which enables you to receive notifications as they happen, regardless of whether you’re on x.com.
You can get notifications for things like Direct Messages, follows, likes, replies to your posts, mentions, and Reposts of your posts.
From a web notification, you can then reply to a post or Direct Message, Repost or like a post, or follow someone back.
Check or uncheck the boxes for the notifications you wish to receive, or change the drop-down selections to see notifications
Log in to x.com using the Chrome or Firefox browser.
. You can turn them off at any time.
When will I receive web or browser notifications?

Whether you've opted to receive web or browser notifications Tailored for you or By anyone, we strive to make sure we notify you only when it's most relevant. You may not receive a notification every time there is activity related to you and your posts. To see a full list of your interactions, check your Notifications tab.
How do I set up push notifications on my mobile device?
Push notifications on mobile devices are set up separately from your web notifications. Learn more
